label: Tencent Cloud Coding Plan Lite
limits: Reportedly 1,200 requests/5h, 9,000/week, 18,000/month (conflicting third-party figures of ~750/5h exist).
notes: Reportedly ¥40/mo list (¥7.9 first month), Pro ¥200/mo. One aggregator reported both tiers sold out on 2026-08-26. No primary source checked. As of 2026-10-14 the coding-plan.org aggregator (secondary) says the whole Coding Plan, Pro included, offers only smart routing ('仅提供智能路由（参数 tc-code-latest），无法指定模型') with no public model list, and that GLM-5 went offline on 10-09. The official page cloud.tencent.com/act/pro/codingplan returned 404 on 2026-10-31.
